name: Tempester n°23: remote panel encoders and controls over NRPN (200-213 encoder steps, 220-229 absolute controls)
explanation: Dependency: requires n°9a (patch/nrpn_reception.json): it reads its NRPN state blocks (DIN [address], USB [address], number word +0 with bit 15 = selected, data MSB << 7 at +2) and relies on it to refuse NRPN numbers >= 200; n°9a must be in the same build. Sound parameters already have NRPN 0-126 (nrpn_reception), but the 4 soft knobs, BPM/Swing, Delay Send, Volume, Distort, Compress, Pan, Level and the knobs' secondary functions could not be reached remotely. Panel path ([routine] [address], main loop): messages 0x30-0x3D = 14 encoders (data bits 0-4 = signed step, 0x10 = sign) -> [routine](e, step) = event signal 5; messages 0x20-0x29 = 10 absolute controls (data 0-255) -> [routine](k, value) = event signal 6; both distributed synchronously. Encoders (cases of [routine] signal 5, Beat Events soft knobs): 0 LFO Rate (Shift: Shape), 1 Pitch (Fine), 2 1/2 Mix / Level (Pre/Post), 3 Shape / Sample, 4 LFO Amount (Destination), 5 Env Amount (Velocity Amt), 6 Env Decay (Release), 7 Env Attack (Sustain), 8 BPM (Swing), 9 Delay Send (Delay Time), 10 soft knob 4, 11 soft knob 3, 12 soft knob 2, 13 soft knob 1. Absolute controls (signal 6): 0 Feedback, 1 Highpass Frequency, 2 Compress, 3 Audio Mod, 4 Resonance, 5 Lowpass Frequency, 6 Pan, 7 Level, 8 Volume, 9 Distort. Fix: the two live callers of [routine] (DIN [address], USB [address]) call a pre-hook (0x9d07c700-0x9d07c817) which, on CC 38 (NRPN data LSB) with NRPN 200-213 or 220-229 selected in nrpn_reception's state of that source (read only: DIN [address], USB [address]), on the Remote Pad IN channel ([address], 0 = All) and when the Debug menu (UI state [address]) is not shown, calls [routine](n - 200, clamp(value - 8192, -16, 15)) (nothing for 0) or [routine](n - 220, min(value, 255)), exactly as [routine] does, then makes the original call to [routine] with the original arguments (nrpn_reception refuses numbers >= 200 without effect). Main loop context. No RAM added. Requires nrpn_reception.

edits.why: jal 0x9d07c700 ; [routine]: was "jal [address]" ([routine]); delay slot "li a0,0x1" (source DIN) kept
jal 0x9d07c700 ; [routine]: was "jal [address]"; delay slot "andi a3,t5,0xff" (value) kept
andi a2,a2,0xff ; Live: a0 = source (1 DIN, 2 USB), a1 = channel 0-15, a2 = CC, a3 = value, ra = caller
bne a2,t0,0x9d07c810 ; only the data LSB (CC 38) applies an NRPN
subu t2,t2,t1 ; NRPN state of this source (nrpn_reception: DIN [address], USB [address])
andi t3,t3,0x3fff ; delay slot: t3 = NRPN number
beq t5,zero,0x9d07c810 ; not 220-229: not ours (nrpn_reception handles or refuses it)
lbu t6,0x49eb(gp) ; Remote Pad IN [address] (0 = All)
beq t6,t7,0x9d07c810 ; Debug menu shown: refused (voice calibration)
lhu t6,0x2(t2) ; delay slot: data MSB << 7
sw ra,0x24(sp) ; the original call is made afterwards with the same arguments
jal [address] ; [routine](encoder, step): event signal 5, as panel messages 0x30-0x3D
jal [address] ; [routine](control, value): event signal 6, as panel messages 0x20-0x29
j [address] ; [routine] with the original arguments (n°21, nrpn_reception, event 10)
